seo.viz_intro: Irvine is not one place with one light. Orchard Hills sits against the ridge where afternoon sun pushes warm colors yellow by two. Woodbury’s garden paseos stay filtered and cool. Hidden Canyon takes canyon mornings and hot open afternoons in the same day. The same white behaves like three different colors across those villages, which is why a fan deck decided indoors tells you almost nothing. Choose a direction below and watch a real home change, then let our design team do it with the front of your house.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to paint a house in Irvine?

Every estimate is itemized line by line: prep, primer, coating, trim and accents priced separately, never a lump sum. Paintable surface is the actual area being coated, which is not the same as your home’s square footage. Call (909) 312-5400 for a walkthrough and an itemized figure.

faqs.q: Which Irvine villages do you serve?
faqs.a: All of them. We have dedicated pages for Orchard Hills, Altair, Portola Springs, Hidden Canyon, Woodbury and Stonegate, and we work throughout the rest of Irvine as well. faqs.q: How do your prices compare to other Irvine contractors?
faqs.a: We are usually more expensive, and we say so plainly. Most painters in this market publish no pricing at all. The difference is in preparation, Sherwin-Williams Emerald and Duration rather than builder-grade product, and seeing the color on your own home before anything is committed. A repaint done twice costs the whole amount again, which is what makes getting it right the first time the cheaper path.

faqs.q: Do you repaint ceilings and interiors, or only exteriors?
faqs.a: Both. Interiors cover walls, ceilings, trim and crown molding, with full masking and daily clean-up. We also refinish kitchen cabinets — doors and drawers sprayed off-site in urethane enamel, boxes sprayed in place, hardware re-hung square, which produces a factory finish rather than a painted one.

faqs.q: How long does an exterior repaint take in Irvine?

faqs.q: What paint do you use, and why does it matter here?
faqs.a: Sherwin-Williams Emerald and Duration exterior systems, applied at the full thickness the manufacturer specifies and never over-thinned. Inland Irvine sun is hard on coatings: builder-grade paint chalks and fades years early, and deep colors in particular fail fast without fade-resistant colorants. All work carries a 2-Year Warranty on labor and materials.

faqs.q: Do you handle HOA and design review approval?
faqs.a: Yes, as part of the project. Nearly every Irvine village requires approval before an exterior color change. We assemble the submission package — swatches, Sherwin-Williams product data sheets and a callout for each side of the house — formatted for your association’s review. We also paint common areas for associations directly; see our HOA and common-area page.

spotlight.body: On Irvine stucco, everything you can see at the end was decided before a drop of color went on. Pressure wash, crack repair floated to match the existing texture, bonding primer on bare surfaces, then Emerald sprayed with a Titan airless and back-rolled so the coating drives into the texture rather than sitting on top of it. Rolling a full exterior is faster for the crew. Spraying is better for the house.
